q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Short answer
- It depends how you compare. Measured: net sales on 2026-10-12 were ₹42,177 — that is 23.0% higher than 2026-10-11 (₹34,377). Measured: vs the diagnostics' “usual” baseline the same day was down sharply (usual ₹104,860 → ₹42,177, −60.0%). So: sales were higher than the previous day but well below the normal/expected level.

Key evidence (measured)
- Net sales — 2026-10-11: ₹34,377 → 2026-10-12: ₹42,177. (Previous → Event) — Measured.  
- Net sales vs usual baseline — usual: ₹104,860 → 2026-10-12: ₹42,177 (−60.0%) — Measured.
- Decomposition (what changed on 2026-10-12 vs the usual level) — Measured: gross_sales fell and explains most of the shortfall (effect −₹66,544, 106% of the net_sales gap). Within that:
  - Product ad spend (P&L basis): usual ₹66,164 → event ₹38,661 (effect −₹27,504) — Measured.  
  - Gross COGS: usual ₹40,893 → event ₹15,813 (effect −₹25,080) — Measured.  
  - Gross profit: usual ₹6,268 → event −₹7,692 (effect −₹13,961) — Measured.
- Channel: ig_feed dropped from ₹49,246 (usual) → ₹4,617 (event) and accounts for ~71% of the change vs usual — Measured.
- Campaigns/ad(s) with abrupt drops: campaign TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ and one campaign id (120250695088250783) went from ₹6,488 (usual) → ₹0 on the event day — Measured.
- Traffic & funnel (moved together): Sessions 3,423 → 3,254; Impressions 153,941 → 133,021; Add-to-cart events 282 → 317 — Measured.

Why (causal statement)
- Diagnose found no single upstream cause that met the causal threshold. The tool reports: no supported cause identified; Sessions and Add‑to‑cart moved with sales (Measured) but were not proven as the cause (Hypothesis: they may be reacting or correlated). The largest arithmetic driver of the gap vs usual is the fall in gross_sales (led by lower product ad spend and lower COGS/gross profit), and a concentrated drop in ig_feed/certain campaigns — these are the best leads to investigate next.
